lines.text: Reply me or reply to me?
Many learners say: Please reply me soon.
Better: Please reply to me soon.
Reply needs to before a person.
Reply to me! Please reply to me soon.

data.why: Reply needs to before a person.

native.tip: reply の後に人を置くときは to が必要です。
native.caption: “Please reply me soon.”と言っていませんか？😅 「返事をください」の感覚で、人をそのまま置いてしまいがちです。“Please reply to me soon.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“reply to me”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Put to before the person: reply to me.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Please reply me soon.” 😅 Do not drop to after reply. The natural way is “Please reply to me soon.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
